title: SEI Layer Growth Model
description: The solid-electrolyte interphase grows on the anode, consuming lithium and raising resistance. Growth follows roughly square-root-of-time kinetics. SEI is the main calendar-aging thief.

demo.code:
import math
t_days = 365
loss = 2.0 * math.sqrt(t_days / 365)
print("1 year calendar loss: %.1f%% (SEI)" % loss)

title: Thermal Aging Acceleration
description: Arrhenius models extrapolate high-temperature aging to use temperature; every 10C roughly doubles the rate. Acceleration compresses years into months. Time gets fast-forwarded.

demo.code:
import math
t1, t2 = 25 + 273, 45 + 273
factor = math.exp(5000 * (1/t1 - 1/t2))
print("45C ages %.1fx faster than 25C" % factor)
